name: team_planning_edit_position
description: Change some fields of a position in a scenario of a Team Planning plan and keep the rest. Give position_id and only the fields to change: an omitted field keeps its value, and an empty string or null clears an optional one, such as cost_centre. Written as one PositionSet, with the same checks as team_planning_set_position. Refused unless the caller is one of the plan's editors. `note` is Markdown: links, **bold**, _italic_, lists and `code` render, a bare URL becomes a link, typed HTML shows as text and images render as links.

scenario_id.description: The scenario, or the plan's id for the baseline.

note.description: Why this is in the plan, such as the business reason for a move. Optional, at most 2000 characters; it never changes what the scenario resolves to. A note on a change to a person goes when they are forgotten. Any other note, such as one on a unit, a position or a rule, stays until the plan is deleted, so keep personal details out of it.
